thread:
alisha: Heads up — I'm starting procurement for the eu-west4 dedicated cluster for team-search. We need quota increases before next Monday: 10 x A100-80GB GPUs (zonal), 15 reserved regional external IPs for NAT, and an increase to 'accelerator' region quota. Filed a GCP case: 1-9876543210. Dropping details here.

martin: Thanks. Do we have an estimate for incremental monthly cost if GCP grants the full request? need an approval path.

alisha: @martin rough calc: 10 A100s on dedicated pricing ~= €40k/mo if on-demand; expect we'll negotiate committed use or use our Dedicated pool — ballpark €20k-€25k/mo if we commit. External IPs negligible by themselves but associated NAT egress could add. Need your sign-off to request expedited escalation.

samira: Can we request a temporary burst window instead of a full quota bump? If we just need capacity for a two-day onboarding test we can ask for time-limited increase. That might be faster and cheaper.

alisha: We prefer a permanent regional increase so Jenkins/job routing doesn't fail next week. But we can ask for a 7-day emergency burst as fallback. Mentioned both in the case.

kevin: FYI current project-level external IP quota shows 0/24 addresses available in eu-west4. That's the blocker for NAT. I'll paste the check command:

kevin: ```
# list regional addresses
gcloud compute addresses list --filter="region:eu-west4" --project redwood-prod
```

alisha: GCP support asked for billing verification and project owner contact. Case update from gcp-support: "Case 1-9876543210 acknowledged, assigned to engineer. Need billing owner confirmation and justification for region+accelerator quota. ETA 48-72h for standard, will escalate on approval."

gcp-support: Hi team — assigned engineer is Lina. To speed escalation, please attach your org billing PO or confirm billing account ID and provide expected sustained usage per week. Also confirm whether VPC-SC or Org Policy blocks allocation of external IPs.

alisha: Billing account ID: 0123-4567-89ab. Justification: Dedicated inference capacity for customer-facing search product, sustained 24/7 inference with average 2M tokens/day initially. Owner: martin@redwood.ai. Also note we need static external IPs to allow downstream partner firewall + private peering setup.

martin: Confirmed — I approve escalation and cost for initial 7-day emergency if that gets us over the hump. I'll sign any billing confirmation docs.

infra-bot: Case 1-9876543210 status -> ESCALATED by alisha at 1861234578. Tagging support-level: P2.

samira: Quick checklist for whoever picks this up: 1) Request 10 A100-80GB zonal (eu-west4-a/b/c) 2) Request regional addresses = 15 3) Ask for a 7-day emergency burst while working on permanent increase 4) Confirm no org-policy deny on compute.addresses 5) Add note to rollout plan to use fallback smaller models if GPUs delayed.

kevin: Also loop in networking: james-fw team needs the reserved IPs to whitelist. Requesting they pre-approve ASN peering and firewall patch window.

alisha: I pushed a reply to the case with the billing ID + ownership + the above checklist. I also attached the sample cost approval email from @martin.

gcp-support: Update: we've validated billing, engineer Lina requested quota storyboards from the internal quota team. They've requested an example instance type and exact accelerator count per zone. Please provide that and we can target a 24h expedited review.

alisha: Provided exact spec: 4 x A100-80GB in eu-west4-a, 3 x in eu-west4-b, 3 x in eu-west4-c (total 10). Regional external IPs: 15. Requested a 7-day burst window starting 2026-03-23 for onboarding.

martin: :thumbsup: go for expedited. If they ask for commitment terms, route to me.

kevin: Noted. I'll reserve a set of ephemeral IPs in the staging project so firewall owners can test rules. Once production IPs are allocated we'll swap.

infra-bot: Case 1-9876543210 update -> quota team requested project-level IAM audit at 1861234610. Please assign someone to confirm no deny policies.

alisha: Assigned to kevin to confirm IAM. Kevin — can you check org policies and confirm by EOD?

kevin: On it, will confirm by 17:00 CET.

samira: If quota doesn't land in time we should fallback to launching smaller instances (4xA100 + 8xA40) and tier traffic. I'll prepare a prompt switch config.

alisha: Thanks all. I'll follow up on the case and post any GCP replies here. If escalation completes earlier I'll update the ticket and then we can spin up infra.

martin: Good thread. Keep the cost notes in the case so procurement can reconcile.

kevin: IAM audit result: no org-policy blocks found, compute.addresses allowed. Pushing proof to the GCP case now.

gcp-support: Lina here — we've provisionally approved a 7-day emergency increase to support onboarding, Case 1-9876543210 -> STATUS: APPROVED (7-day). Final allocation pending zone availability. ETA final allocation 12-24h.

alisha: Fantastic. Stand by for allocation. Will schedule cluster creation once IPs + GPUs are confirmed.

martin: Thanks team.
